## Course overview

**MLS 202: Blood Transfusion Techniques** is presented within Medical Laboratory Sciences at Southern Africa Nazarene University. These learning materials are organized around the three units supplied for this website.

| Unit | Topics | Learning activities |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Foundations, immunohematology and genetic principles | Antibody comparison, compatibility scenarios |
| 2 | ABO, H and secretor blood group systems | Genotype–phenotype prediction, grouping interpretation |
| 3 | Other clinically significant blood group systems | Antibody identification and clinical significance |

## Learning approach

- **Before class:** review the reading notes and learning outcomes.
- **During class:** discuss worked transfusion cases and laboratory decision points.
- **After class:** answer the practice questions and refer to lecture PDFs.

## Assessment

Your lecturer will supply authoritative assessment weights, dates and submission procedures separately. No unverified grading timetable is published here.
